test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

She was stuck in __his imagination for many a hour as a force__ to be reckoned with.

options.text: his imagination for many hour as a force
his imagination for many an hour as a force
his imagination for many an hours as a force

solution:
The correct answer is **"his imagination for many an hour as a force"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase '**many an hour**' or '**many a/an [singular noun]**' is used to emphasize that **something happened** or **will happen a lot of times** or **for a large amount of time**. It's often used in more **formal **or **poetic **contexts.
 
• Here we will see the correct sentence:
 
• She was stuck in** his imagination for many an hour as a force** to be reckoned with.​

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's learn the sentence formation:

 
• It should be **"an"** instead of **"a"**
 
• **"A"** goes before words that begin with consonants
 
• **"An"** goes before words that begin with vowels
